passage.text:
TEXT A - Hotel Booking Confirmation

Reservation Number: HTL-789456
Guest: Sarah Johnson
Check-in: May 15, 2026 (3:00 PM)
Check-out: May 18, 2026 (11:00 AM)

Thank you for choosing Seaside Resort! We are delighted to confirm your reservation for a superior ocean-view room. Our complimentary breakfast buffet is served daily from 7-10 AM. The hotel features an outdoor pool, fitness center, and spa facilities. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property.

Please note that early check-in is subject to availability. If you have any special requests or need to modify your reservation, contact us at least 48 hours in advance. We have a flexible cancellation policy - free cancellation up to 24 hours before arrival. Our dedicated staff looks forward to making your stay memorable!

TEXT B - Airline Travel Advisory

Important Notice for Flight SK2045 (May 15, 2026)

Due to adverse weather conditions, Flight SK2045 departure time has been adjusted from 9:00 AM to 11:30 AM. Passengers are advised to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before the new departure time. This delay is temporary and necessary to ensure passenger safety.

Complimentary meal vouchers will be provided to all affected passengers. Please proceed to the airline counter to collect your voucher. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding.
